mentions.name: Minimalist recipe app
mentions.description: This app provides a minimalistic, ad-free cooking and recipe experience, focusing on core functionality that works well with bugs fixed quickly, aiming to be the best recipe tool without bloat.
mentions.problem: Most recipe apps and websites are painful to use.
mentions.audience: General consumers who cook and are frustrated with existing recipe apps and websites.
mentions.source_excerpt: A recipe app you will actually want to use. No bloat, no ads, very minimalistic but everything works well and bugs gets fixed.

evidence.value: A recipe app you will actually want to use. No bloat, no ads, very minimalistic but everything works well and bugs gets fixed.
